result.reason: The redline does not reach the preferred position or fallback. It retains exclusivity for the full agreement term rather than limiting it to 12 months, and the covered category remains broad and open-ended through references to “substantially similar” products and similar companies. The termination trigger also applies only after a 30-day cure period, rather than automatically upon failure to meet service levels or delivery dates. Further, terminating “HDI’s exclusive right” may not clearly terminate the Company’s separate nonparticipation covenant. The added language generally preserves unrelated commercial terms, but it is both insufficient and ambiguous.
